summary: Pinterest requires a mandatory application review process before you can access the API. The setup involves verifying your account, accepting terms, and waiting for manual approval from Pinterest.

approval.notes: Application requests are reviewed by Pinterest, and you will receive an email notification regarding approval or denial.

steps.title: Verify account and accept terms
steps.detail: Verify your account's email address and go to 'My apps' to accept the Developer Terms of Service.

steps.title: Register app details
steps.detail: Submit your application details for review to receive your app ID and secret key.

steps.title: Configure redirect URI
steps.detail: On the Configure tab, scroll to the Redirect URIs section, enter your URI, and select Add to save.

nuances: Approval is required for access; you cannot use the API immediately after registration.
Trial access is a specific tier that may be granted after review.
Product limited tokens are available after approval to test without a full OAuth flow.
agent_can_do: Draft the application name and description for the submission form.
Store the app ID and secret key in environment variables once provided.
Write code to handle the OAuth 2.0 authorization flow.
human_must_do: Accept the Developer Terms of Service in the console.
